project.name: Fieldstone · Ember launch
project.description: Harbor & Pine (fictional agency) x Fieldstone Coffee Roasters (fictional client): every role's tool notes on the Ember launch, one fact per record, word for word. Created by the memorylake-usecases agency-project-memory demo.

records.text: Dana confirmed on today's call: the Ember landing page goes live two weeks from today. She wants a screenshot the morning it is up.
Task 'Ember landing page: go live' is blocked, waiting on the hero video for the page header. Status: not started.
Spoke to the photographer: the Ember hero video lands tomorrow, final cut with captions.
Task 'Ember hero video: final cut' is assigned to the photographer; the landing page header and the six launch posts wait on it.
Ember launch plan, approved by Dana Whitfield: the paid social budget is the same as last quarter, split 60/40 between Instagram and TikTok.
Fieldstone paid social spend, Q2 2026 (closed): $40,000.
Fieldstone paid social spend, Q3 2026 (closed): $62,000, including the summer cold brew push.
All Ember launch assets use the new lockup; the old one is retired. Please update the bag mockups and the landing page header.
Fieldstone lockup v2 approved by Dana Whitfield: the wordmark with the kiln mark. Replaces v1 everywhere.
Fieldstone lockup v3 approved by Dana Whitfield: the holiday wreath variant of v2, for the December gifting campaign only.
Please hold every Ember social post until the end of the month; our board sees the launch plan first.
Six Ember launch posts drafted and approved by Dana; waiting on a posting date.
Ember launch email scheduled to send on 2026-10-20 at 09:00 ET to the full subscriber list.
Creative concept for Ember: slow-roasted for long evenings. Warm amber palette, candlelight photography, no latte art.
Copy rules for Ember: lead with the smoky caramel note, say direct trade rather than ethically sourced until the certificate number arrives, never say artisanal.
Landing page copy approved by Dana: headline 'Ember. Slow-roasted for long evenings.' with three short paragraphs on origin, roast and brewing.
Task 'Print files to the printer' due 2026-10-23: the bag labels and the in-store poster.
The printer confirmed the bag label stock. No change to the print date.
Instagram crops for the six Ember launch posts are 4:5, TikTok covers 9:16. All six drafts are in the Ember social frame.
Dana prefers status updates on Thursdays: one email, bullet points, no decks.
